basic_info.description: 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, 1223 sqft in Landing, San Francisco Shipyard's latest released Luxury Collection. Cozy and comfortable condo. Beautiful massive windows all around flooding with natural sunlight. Modern open kitchen featuring quartz countertops and contemporary cabinets. Parking space is assigned to every home inside garage. Convenient, but private located in Hunters Point. Minutes away from Bayview and San Bruno Ave. Enjoy the beautiful SF bay view. Make this luxury modern condo your home now.
